name_input: The Gourmet Jar (Apeksha Gourmet Jar Private Limited)
note: Legal entity name confirmed only from the company's own website: the Terms of Service page of thegourmetjar.com states 'This website (TheGourmetJar.com) is operated by Apeksha Gourmet Jar Pvt. Ltd.' (https://www.thegourmetjar.com/policies/terms-of-service). The About Us page names Apeksha Jain as 'Chief Confiturier' and describes an in-house team producing the jars (https://www.thegourmetjar.com/pages/about-us), and the Shipping policy confirms pan-India dispatch of own-brand goods (https://www.thegourmetjar.com/policies/shipping-policy) — consistent with a manufacturer_trader role, but this is a self-declaration, not a registry record. NOT VERIFIED / NOT PUBLICLY RETRIEVED: CIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, date of incorporation, registered-office state and MCA status. The claimed PAN AAKCA9439Q could not be checked against any public source and is therefore returned as null rather than confirmed; note that the 4th character 'C' would indicate a company-type holder, which is at least consistent with a Pvt Ltd, but this is inference only, not verification. No audited accounts or MCA filings were reachable, so revenue FY25 and FY26 are null — no figures invented. Tooling limitation: the web_search backend was unavailable (connection refused) and all registry aggregators tried (ZaubaCorp, TheCompanyCheck, Tofler, InstaFinancials) returned 403/404 or unusable results, and Bing/Google returned irrelevant SERPs, so MCA/GST portals could not be queried. State: registered office state could not be confirmed; the claimed Uttar Pradesh is unverified. No rejection grounds found — the entity demonstrably exists and operates a live commercial website; it is not struck off, liquidated or bankrupt as far as could be determined. HS codes 200791/200799 (jams, fruit jellies, marmalades, pastes) are plausible for this product range but were not assessed here per role scope. Recommend re-verification of CIN/PAN/GSTIN on mca.gov.in and the GST portal when search access is restored.
